The open_vocabulary_detector's 8 zebra detections corroborates the count error. The fine_grained_classifier confirming 'zebra' as top prediction validates presence atoms.

The major penalties come from fusion (severity 4) and structural collapse (severity 3), which are appropriately weighted.

7. Upward Override Justification: I made NO upward overrides. Every positive verdict was independently verified against visual evidence. For instance, I confirmed the truck's taxonomy compliance by observing the enclosed cab, open bed, and elevated clearance myself.
